articles.summary: This award recognizes Dr. Shao’s dedication to advancing NAD+ research and scientific excellence responsibly within the dietary supplement industry Niagen Bioscience, Inc. (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announces that Radicle Science and Council for Responsible Nutrition (CRN) honored Andrew Shao, Ph.D., Senior Vice President of Global Regulatory and Scientific Affairs at Niagen Bioscience, as the winner of the 2026 Annette Dickinson Trailblazer Award . Radicle Science Co-founder and CEO Jeff Chen with Andrew Shao, SVP, Global Scientific and Regulatory Affairs, Niagen Bioscience, Radicle Science Co-founder and Executive Chair Pelin Thorogood, and CRN President CEO Steve Mister. “This award is incredibly special to me because I had the privilege of working alongside Annette for many years, and that experience has had a lasting impact both on me personally and my career,” said Dr.
articles.title: Andrew Shao, Ph.D., Senior Vice President of Global Regulatory and Scientific Affairs at Niagen Bioscience, Honored with the 2026 Annette Dickinson Trailblazer Award by Radicle Science and Council for Responsible Nutrition (CRN)

articles.summary: Niagen Bioscience, Inc. Niagen Bioscience Chief Executive Officer, Robert Fried, will present on Wednesday, October 21st at 1:30 p.m. PT. To register for the Niagen Bioscience webcast, please visit www.ldmicroevents.com . Chief Financial Officer, Ozan Pamir, will join Mr. Fried and be available for one-on-one meetings with institutional investors at the conference. If you would like to schedule a one-on-one meeting with the Niagen Bioscience management team during the conference, please contact your respective conference representative or email Niagen@KCSA.com .
